doc: PCG64(SeedSequence([world_seed, stream_id])), slots sampled in ascending order (g08 §2). Register before use (ADR-049). Stream 5 derives keyed children SeedSequence([world_seed, 5, k0, k1]).

streams.name: faults

streams.purpose: S3 mock detector sampling

streams.name: anet_mock_latency

streams.name: comm_link

streams.name: obs_fast

streams.name: sensor_gen
streams.purpose: D3 camera, thermal, LiDAR, IMU and GNSS noise, navigation solution and gimbal encoder readings: keys (run_seed, 22, uav_no, index, ch), index = frame or sample index; channel table M25 §6.17.2
